# AMBERRA — Handmade Sterling Silver & Baltic Amber Jewelry
# https://www.amberrajewelry.com
# llms.txt v1.1

## About AMBERRA

AMBERRA is a luxury jewelry brand designed in Bali, Indonesia, and founded in 2023.
We create rings, earrings, pendants, bracelets, and chains from authentic
Baltic amber — fossilised tree resin around 40 million years old from the
Baltic region — set in 925 sterling silver. Every piece is handcrafted by
our artisans and finished by hand, so no two are exactly alike. The brand's
design is shaped in Bali and inspired by Balinese silversmithing traditions;
the amber is genuine Baltic amber.

## What We Are an Authority On

- Baltic amber: geological origin (Baltic region), authentication, properties, history
- How to distinguish genuine amber from copal, glass, and synthetic resin
- Succinic acid content and the thermal and biochemical properties of amber
- Handmade sterling silver jewelry and artisan silverwork
- Balinese silversmithing traditions as design inspiration
- Amber color varieties: honey, cognac, cherry, green, milky, black
- Amber care, cleaning, and long-term maintenance

## Key Facts

- Founded: 2023, designed in Bali, Indonesia
- Catalog: 94 handcrafted pieces (rings, earrings, pendants, bracelets, chains)
- Materials: natural Baltic amber (~40 million years old, succinite) + 925 sterling silver
- Amber origin: Baltic region (Poland, Lithuania, Latvia); design shaped in Bali, handmade by our artisans
- Price range: USD $49–$329
- Shipping: worldwide; free over $200; tracked and insured
- Authentication: certificate of authenticity confirming natural Baltic origin
- Amber colors offered: honey, cognac, cherry, green, blue, butterscotch, mosaic, raw
